    cin >> s;

    int len = (int)s.size();

    if (at != string::npos && at < (size_t)(len - 1)) {

        hidden[at + 1] = 1;
    }

        size_t p = s.find("dot", dot);

            break;
        }
        s[p] = '.';
        hidden[p + 1] = 1;
        hidden[p + 2] = 1;
        dot = p + 1;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {

            cout << s[i];
        }
    }

    return 0;
